mapper.select: SELECT pipeline_name, phase, export_requested, owner_node, lease_until, updated_at FROM pipeline_control WHERE pipeline_name = #{pipelineName}
mapper.update: UPDATE pipeline_control SET phase = 'IMPORTING', owner_node = #{nodeId}, lease_until = now() + (#{leaseSeconds} * interval '1 second'), updated_at = now() WHERE pipeline_name = #{pipelineName} AND export_requested = false AND ( phase = 'IDLE' OR lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < now() )
UPDATE pipeline_control SET export_requested = true, updated_at = now() WHERE pipeline_name = #{pipelineName}

UPDATE pipeline_control SET phase = 'EXPORTING', owner_node = #{nodeId}, lease_until = now() + (#{leaseSeconds} * interval '1 second'), updated_at = now() WHERE pipeline_name = #{pipelineName} AND export_requested = true AND ( phase = 'IDLE' OR lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < now() )
UPDATE pipeline_control SET phase = 'IDLE', owner_node = null, lease_until = null, updated_at = now() WHERE pipeline_name = #{pipelineName} AND phase = 'IMPORTING' AND owner_node = #{nodeId}

UPDATE pipeline_control SET phase = 'IDLE', export_requested = false, owner_node = null, lease_until = null, updated_at = now() WHERE pipeline_name = #{pipelineName} AND phase = 'EXPORTING' AND owner_node = #{nodeId}
